courses.mapping_gap: No responsible local career node can be verified because the official M.Tech route currently serves B.Tech content and exposes no M.Tech specialization.

agent_notes: Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; after confirming the expected public search and official hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure.
The official site confirms Poornima College of Engineering at Sitapura, Jaipur and distinguishes PCE from PIET through the PCE seat columns and REAP code 1023.
Only programme rows with non-dash PCE availability were included; PIET-only rows were excluded to avoid mixing campuses.

The official navigation lists Master of Technology ( M. Tech ), but /admission/m-tech currently serves B.Tech content and exposes no M.Tech duration, eligibility, or specialization catalogue. The record therefore requires manual review and the catalogue is partial.
The official PCE.pdf brochure link was checked, but it is image-only for command-line text extraction and did not resolve the missing current M.Tech catalogue.
